## Design

### 2026-10-05 — I started to make the schematic. First i did the RGB and the switches, and I need them to be hotswappable, so I changed their footprints in KiCad to a hotswappable switch. Then I did all of the needed

**6h**

I started to make the schematic. First i did the RGB and the switches, and I need them to be hotswappable, so I changed their footprints in KiCad to a hotswappable switch. Then I did all of the needed capacitors and resistors for the PMIC, battery, and microcontroller. Also ran into a problem. My RGB needed 3.7 volts but I designed the power to be 3.3v. I ended up using a boost converter to fix this issue
